singleSourced.context: In some industry news this week, Fortnite creator Epic Games has reportedly told developers behind a new Disney title "to use more artificial intelligence tools" to complete it, after delaying the project.

singleSourced.key: shooter featuring characters from the marvel and star wars
singleSourced.value: shooter featuring characters from the Marvel and Star Wars
singleSourced.context: According to Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier, developers working on this Disney video game collaboration, which is described as a "shooter featuring characters from the Marvel and Star Wars" universe, have apparently been instructed to implement an "AI first" production model from here on out.
In an internal messaged reviewed by Bloomberg, a game director supposedly told staff there would be "no more hand-written code" and art would be generated with "AI workflows".
It's claimed this announcement has left "some Epic developers stunned".
As part of this, the plan was to create a "games and entertainment universe" over a "multiyear project".
